items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: So they come out and done their act and broke it up. So they act -- and me, I had never done that before... So anyway when I come off, we had in my dressing room, Derby and Bailey, a whole big quart of booze.

ctx.x: Yeah, so after he sit down, she resumed her act. Now, at about 15 minutes intermission before the second part of the show come on, us, they opened the show with us. Now, we had been back there tasting, and everybody feeling fine, fine. No pain. Like I told you, we had our own stage, own stage rolled down and rolled back, had our own lights, the pinpoint lights, so Duke say, I want the stage completely dark, one pinpoint spot on Sonny because we opened with "Ring Dem Bells" and the stage is dark, the only thing…

The curtain broke, and the spot's on me and all you can is my face and my hands, hitting anything. I don't know whether it was right or wrong. Just making some noise. Man, about the eighth bar, they stood up, standing ovation. They hadn't seen the whole band yet. Stood up, cheers.
